text: Deling City one-time event bits. Bit 1 is set when General Caraway locks the party in his mansion (and lets the party move on afterwards), bit 2 when the hatch in the Presidential Residence corridor has been opened, and bits 4, 32, 64 and 128 when the matching switches in the Deling sewers have been used.

Deling sewer switches, second set: bits 1, 2, 32 and 64 are set by switches in the second sewer room and bits 4, 8 and 16 by switches in the third; the earlier rooms read them to know which gates are open. Two Balamb Town centre fields also test the whole byte as 0 or 1 to choose a movie.

Reused byte. In the Deling sewers bits 1, 2 and 4 mark switches used and bit 64 marks Weapons Monthly (May issue) as already taken; in the Centra Ruins tower bits 16 and 32 mark the left and right ladders used; in Caraway's Mansion bit 128 marks that the Ifrit card was given to Caraway, and bit 8 is only ever cleared.

Reused scratch byte. In the Garden Festival fields it holds which SeeD (1 Quistis, 2 Selphie, 3 Irvine) goes with Xu to the front gate; in Squall's fistfight in Balamb Garden it counts punches (Deathblow unlocks at 3); in Fisherman's Horizon's concert fields it is the member being given an instrument (1 Zell, 2 Irvine, 3 Selphie, 4 Quistis); in the Deling sewers (1 to 25) it records which ladder or room the party last used; in Caraway's Mansion (1 to 12) it is Zell's escape-search step; in the desert fields it stores a party member.

Reused scratch byte. In Caraway's Mansion it is Selphie's escape-search step (1 to 9) that changes her dialogue; at the Fisherman's Horizon concert it is set from the band's instrument lineup (0 to 3) and later read on the roof to vary Rinoa's lines; in the desert road it stores a party member; the Balamb Garden classroom attack resets it to 0.

Deling City bus route in progress: the number of the stop-to-stop leg the bus is travelling (1 to 16), set when the player boards and cleared to 0 when the bus arrives. It tells each stop's scene where the bus comes from.

Galbadia Garden event bits. Bit 1 is set after the waiting scene in the dorm room and starts the Raijin and Fujin meeting in the hall, which then sets bit 2; bits 16, 32 and 64 mean Card Keys 1, 2 and 3 have been received during the later infiltration (they unlock the matching doors and the elevator); bit 128 means a ground-floor door lock has been opened; bit 4 marks Irvine's talk in the viewing area.

flags.2: Raijin and Fujin met in the hall

Mixed event bits. Bit 8 is on while the Odin timer runs in the Centra Ruins and is cleared when it ends; bits 16, 32, 64 and 128 mean Galbadia Garden's Lock 1, Lock 2 (two doors) and Lock 3 doors have been opened; bit 4 means the Solomon Ring was taken in Esthar; bit 1 marks a one-time scene already played in the Fisherman's Horizon concert area.

Music-part mask for the Garden Festival concert at Fisherman's Horizon: each of the four music choices (variables 346-349) switches on a set of music channels, and the combined mask is given to the music engine when the show starts. It is reset to 0 when the concert scene is left.

The first digit (0-9) of the five-digit code in the Centra Ruins statue puzzle. It is rolled at random when the stone in the Sphinx room is pushed; the roof room shows the code once the statue has both eyes, and the tower room accepts it when the same digits are entered.

The second digit (0-9) of the five-digit code in the Centra Ruins statue puzzle. It is rolled at random when the stone in the Sphinx room is pushed; the roof room shows the code once the statue has both eyes, and the tower room accepts it when the same digits are entered.

The third digit (0-9) of the five-digit code in the Centra Ruins statue puzzle. It is rolled at random when the stone in the Sphinx room is pushed; the roof room shows the code once the statue has both eyes, and the tower room accepts it when the same digits are entered.

flags.8: Lunar Base passage crew talked to

The Art Gallery and Prison Cell bits work the other way round: they are set to make the guardian appear (after reading the painting title, or taking the Prison Key) and cleared after the fight.

Error ratio of the missiles, set at the Missile Base monitor room. It starts at 0, goes down by 6 per press up to -150, which is the maximum error ratio.

Current position in the Tomb of the Unknown King maze, used to decide where each passage leads. 0 is the entrance and 73 to 76 mark rooms 1 to 4.

text: State of the disciplinary committee scene in the Balamb Garden cafeteria with Seifer, Fujin and Raijin.

Missile Base self-destruct and ID card flags. Bits 1, 2, 4 and 8 record the chosen countdown (10, 20, 30 or 40 minutes); the higher bits track the control room exit door, the missile-fired scene and the wounded soldier.
Set to 15 when the Missile Base self-destruct countdown starts; maps combine it with the countdown bits of the previous variable to tell that a timer is running and blow the base when it ends.

Progress counter for separate story segments, reused by each: the Dollet SeeD exam (2 to 12), Laguna's patrol (500, 510), the Timber missions (100 to 206), the White SeeD ship (700 to 740) and Laguna's Esthar prison and lab (1000 to 1120).
Event flags for the Dollet SeeD exam, read when the SeeD rank is worked out. The crab fight adds points unless the pub escape bit is set.
Read only at the Dollet seaside, where a value of 1 changes the opening scene. Only the debug rooms ever set it, so in normal play it stays 0.
Selects the footstep sound set used in Dollet: 0 on the beach side and 1 in the town. It is switched on a line across the town gate and set when the town loads.
Dollet event flags: forcing past the guard, the pub card player, the pub owner's cards, and the hotel clerk's accent chat. Bit 64 is toggled during the painter's boy and dog events.
Dollet painting and buried-treasure hunt flags. After seeing each of three paintings in the painter's house, a dog at the matching spot digs up an item.
Timber one-time event flags. The boy who asks whether to give up uses bits 32 and 64; other bits mark Timber scenes at the gate, TV station and houses.

flags.32: Boy asked whether to give up

text: Timber and Dollet one-time event flags: Big Brother's speech, the secret savings in a cupboard, and two magazines.
Laguna's Esthar road escape: records the lost keys and the traps Laguna sets (hatch, small boulder, big boulder, about-to-fall boulder). The fights near the exit depend on which traps were prepared.
Event flags of Laguna's Esthar sequence and the Esthar lab: tampering with the hatch levers, ladders in the Laguna field maps and one magazine pickup.
Event flags from Laguna's Esthar sequence and the White SeeD ship. Bit 8 marks the third hatch lever; the ship bits mark Zone's book, Watts's news about Ellone and a joke heard.
Stage counter for the train scenes (Timber-bound train and the other trains) in the bvtr maps. The values rise through the ride and set the cast positions; 50 is the arrival announcement for Timber.
Remembers which way the party left the last Fisherman's Horizon bridge, roof or fishing area, or Deep Sea tower floor, so the next map puts them at the matching entrance.

values.8: Moved between Deep Sea tower floors

text: Set to 1 after Quistis has explained the GF junction tutorial at the Balamb Garden gate, so the explanation is not repeated.
Set to 1 when the party pays at the Fisherman's Horizon hotel counter and goes to sleep, and back to 0 when Squall wakes in the room.

Single-value stage marker (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 or 128) set in different Fisherman's Horizon scenes around the Master Fisherman and the fishing shop and tested for equality; its exact purpose isn't clear.

Two uses. At Fisherman's Horizon it records which of the two lift-operator brothers Squall has talked to (1 top, 2 bottom). In the Chocobo Forest it records the chocobo state: 32 once a chocobo is found and 64 once Squall rode it out.
Fisherman's Horizon sequence about the Garden repair and Irvine with the technicians, advancing one step each time: the lift ride, the roof, the technicians' 'It's working!' and the deck reaction.

Progress through a chain of scenes in Fisherman's Horizon with the Master Fisherman, the Shopkeeper, the Fisherkid and Kazu. The Shumi Village workshop also reads it and shows the Master Fisherman once it reaches 16 or more.

values.32: Kazu talks to Irvine on the bridge
values.64: Kazu says he will do something

text: Deep Sea Research Center puzzle: layout of tower level 3. It is 1 after the reset at level 1, then the level sets 2, 4 or 8 from the Reserve Steam Pressure the player arrives with (12, 14 or 15). Later values record the Steam Room.

values.32: Steam Room already used to refill

text: Deep Sea Research Center puzzle: layout of tower level 4. It is 1 after the reset at level 1, then the level sets 2, 4 or 8 from the Reserve Steam Pressure the player arrives with.
Deep Sea Research Center puzzle: layout of tower level 5. It is 1 after the reset at level 1, then the level sets 2, 4 or 8 from the Reserve Steam Pressure and layout of the level above.

Progress through the end of the Deep Sea Research Center: reset at level 1, opening the door to the ocean deposit, the ruins, and the final battle. From 32 on, random battles in the tower and ruins are switched off.

values.2: Zell forced door; ruins have battles

text: Small event flags for two unrelated places: bits 1, 2 and 8 are set as Squall passes through the Fisherman's Horizon repair shop, and bit 4 is set in Artisan's house in Shumi Village after Artisan's "great honor" line. Their purpose isn't clear.

Two uses. On Battleship Island it records the visit and, at 4, that the island is finished; the Deep Sea tower's opening scene plays only at 4. Inside the Deep Sea tower it records which level terminal has been used.
Reserve Steam Pressure left in the Deep Sea Research Center puzzle, from 0 to 20. Each terminal subtracts the amount the player picks and the Steam Room adds some back.
State of Chocobo Forest 1 (Beginner level). Values 1 and 2 are the ChocoWhis state shared by all six forests; 128 belongs to this forest and means its reward (Aura Stone) was collected.
State of Chocobo Forest 2 (Beginner level). Values 1 and 2 are the ChocoWhis state shared by all six forests; 128 belongs to this forest and means its reward (Flare Stone) was collected.

State of Chocobo Forest 3 (Intermediate level). Values 1 and 2 are the ChocoWhis state shared by all six forests; 128 belongs to this forest and means its reward (Shell Stone and Holy Stone) was collected.
State of the Chocobo holy ground, the seventh forest, in the order of the Chocoboy's scenes there: first talk, mother chocobos gathering, and the Chocobo Card.

State of Chocobo Forest 5 (Expert level). Values 1 and 2 are the ChocoWhis state shared by all six forests; 128 belongs to this forest and means its reward (Meteor, Holy and Ultima Stones) was collected.

State of Chocobo Forest 6 (Intermediate level). Values 1 and 2 are the ChocoWhis state shared by all six forests; 128 belongs to this forest and means its reward (Protect and Meteor Stones) was collected.

State of Chocobo Forest 7 (Expert level). Values 1 and 2 are the ChocoWhis state shared by all six forests; 128 belongs to this forest and means its reward (Meteor, Flare and Ultima Stones) was collected.
Progress of the Shumi Village scenes after the statue is finished: the Attendant reports it, the Elder thanks the group and speaks with his Attendant, then offers the Attendant a visit to Laguna.

values.1: Attendant says the statue is finished
values.4: Elder thanked the group; private talk
values.16: Elder lets the Attendant go see Laguna

Balamb Town flag byte set during the Big Bad Rascal's talk about hiding something in Zell's room, by the station and the Zell's house maps, and cleared by the town setup script. Its bits are not clearly tied to single events.
Flag byte used by Balamb Town maps (hotel, station, port) and the Garden library. Bit 128 is set after the fish cook's talk at the port. Its other bits are not clearly tied to events.

Counts how many times the player has pushed the chocobo in Winhill (0 to 5); it becomes 6 when the chocobo runs off and its other copy appears.
Progress of the scenes in the Balamb Garden master's room with NORG. The values rise in steps of two, up to the battle against NORG and the scene after it.

Flags for the Trabia Garden scenes (the donation drive at the gate and the student who scolds the dreamer) and for the occupied Balamb Town gate.

Flag byte used by occupied Balamb Town maps, the Garden library and the library's Zell quiz setup. Bits 8 and 64 are tested in many town maps; their exact purpose isn't clear.
Flag byte for the occupied Balamb Town captain hunt, also used in the Garden library.

Squall's current outfit as shown on the field: it picks his model in every map. The Garden dorm lets the player change between uniforms and street clothes. A debug room also offers a bandage outfit (3).
Zell's current outfit on the field; it picks his model in every map and follows the same scheme as Squall's.
Selphie's current outfit on the field; it picks her model in the maps. The Balamb Garden classroom map assigns her a random outfit from the three when entered under certain conditions.
Quistis' current outfit on the field.

A shared timer value. At the end of the Dollet mission it stores the countdown reading, which the SeeD field exam turns into its 'Conduct' score (under 180 gives -100, over 1499 gives +80). In the Timber TV-station cable section it is the remaining time in seconds, and in Timber's plan briefing it holds the explanation topic Rinoa is giving (0 to 3).

During the Dollet mission, the number of enemies killed (the kill counter at the end minus its value at the start); the SeeD field exam turns it into the 'Attack' score. In Timber it is reused as a flag set to 1 once Rinoa has explained everything about the plan.

Reused many times. In Dollet it counts mistakes during the field exam (+1 to +20 each) and feeds the 'Attitude' score. In Timber it counts abduction-plan attempts. In Deling City it holds a random code number that the Tomb of the Unknown King guard asks for. In disc 3 it holds which character went to space with Squall.

During the Dollet mission, the number of battles escaped (counter at the end minus counter at the start), used for the 'Spirit' score of the SeeD field exam. In Deling City it counts the 3,000 Gil hints bought from Caraway's guard (0 to 2). In Timber it counts failures of the abduction plan.
